title: Seth Klarman - Baupost Group Portfolio
summary:
We explore how Klarman thinks about margin of safety, patience, and capital preservation — and what long-term investors can learn from Baupost’s portfolio construction. In this episode of PortfolioCasts , we break down the Baupost Group portfolio and discuss holdings across consumer, industrial, financial, and technology sectors — including Google, Dollar General, UNP, and CRH.
